title_zh: 先评估社团设备再编维修预算

scenario.goal_zh: 核对设备清单与状况评估的区别，并安排检查后再确定维修预算

context_zh: 小型表演社团的财务负责人贝森和管理员艾萨克准备年度设备记录。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Treasurer Bethan
sentences.text: Our accountant needs the equipment list by Friday. Do we check every item annually?

sentences.speaker: Manager Isaac
sentences.text: Yes. I have counted the chairs and lights, but the piano still needs a condition assessment.

sentences.speaker: Treasurer Bethan
sentences.text: It is the club's most valuable asset. A price on a list will not tell us whether it needs work.

sentences.speaker: Manager Isaac
sentences.text: Exactly. Do you anticipate any major repairs this year?

sentences.speaker: Treasurer Bethan
sentences.text: I cannot say yet. One key sticks, but we should get the technician's report before putting a repair figure in the budget.

sentences.speaker: Manager Isaac
sentences.text: I will arrange that inspection and mark the condition as not yet assessed. You can send the counted items to the accountant now.

sentences.speaker: Treasurer Bethan
sentences.text: Agreed. I will explain that the piano report will follow, rather than inventing a cost.
